task: T-079 / LiveKit Egress captures private screen previews every 30 seconds
change: The authenticated API starts track-scoped LiveKit ParticipantEgress jobs that overwrite a private JPEG every 30 seconds. The API normalizes and keeps only the latest bounded frame in memory, publishes metadata-only realtime hints, and serves the frame through the existing lease/channel ACL. Client uploads are disabled; Web and Flutter send lease heartbeats and retain local immediate previews. Revocation, stop and lease expiry stop Egress and remove the private files. Per-lease locks keep slow Egress control calls for one publisher from blocking another publisher's snapshots. Egress reconciliation retries after a LiveKit startup race, ambiguous Egress-start responses remain stoppable, and an already prepared shared volume no longer requires chmod by the non-root API user.

checks.name: backend_screen_preview_unit_tests
checks.detail: Go screen-preview, LiveKit Egress, in-memory store, API, runtime configuration and route tests passed; the race detector also passed. Coverage includes the 30-second Egress output request, idempotent job ensure, per-lease concurrency isolation, cleanup after an ambiguous Egress-start response, shared-volume permissions, retry after a transient startup reconciliation failure, bounded JPEG normalization, metadata-only hints, ACL reads, cleanup and lease expiry without frame-driven lease renewal.
